newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Portuguese shares mixed, price data lift market.
newsitem.headline: Portuguese shares mixed, price data lift market.

text.p: 1720 GMT - Portuguese shares ended mixed in line with European stocks which consolidated. Favourable March Portuguese inflation data boosted sentiment. Turnover was eight billion escudos, in line with the recent daily average. Foreign investors took profits in shares of Portugal Telecom. Cement firm Cimpor and bank Banco Comercial Portugues firmed and accounted for 30 percent of the day's turnover. Dealers noted interest in BCP as today was the last trading day before the payment of dividends. "We are very dependent on foreign markets and will continue to follow them," said one operator. "Conditions exist for the Lisbon market to strengthen."
